issues.title: fix(frontend): delegate revision row controls to FsusUI
issues.body:
## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

## Scope Summary

- P2 correction: revision title and secondary text previously imposed body colors over the public primary Button background. Both now inherit the Button foreground, including selected and disabled states; title/meta hierarchy remains in the original sizes and weights.

- WIP / R15 only: migrate the existing revision-selection row in `src/frontend/src/components/admin/article/ArticleRevisionPanel.vue` from a native button to the existing type-preserving `FsusUiButton` adapter. No other production path is owned by this change.
- Exact Blog base `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`, original owned-file blob `8393e632287260a6ce9220a0b42f821e9779e696`. Independent issue-scoped branch; no donor or prior task changes imported.
- Use public plain/default-primary and inline-action Button variants. The original revision object, list/key order, aria-current and `loading || rollbacking` disabled expression are retained. Product text/metadata/actor layout remains local; copied generic border/background/padding/hover/transition rules are removed.
- Refresh, rollback event values, trimming/minimum reason, selected-revision watcher/reset, revision data/authority and all adjacent controls remain unchanged. No new wrapper control, fallback, registry, permission, API, schema, receipt or capability is added.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [ ] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [ ] External naming exception
- Contract impact: compatible

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`: HOLD.
- [ ] Targeted backend tests: HOLD.
- [x] Targeted frontend checks: original full application typecheck and original strict source comparison executed; full app remains FAIL, owned-file strict check PASS on base and head. Details below.
- [x] Other: exact source/blob and public adapter/Button source inspection; original resolver identifies the real UI961 checkout.

## UI Evidence

- [ ] Screenshots or video attached for UI changes: HOLD.
- [ ] Mobile layout checked: HOLD.
- [ ] Dark mode checked: HOLD.
- [x] Accessibility and reduced-motion impact considered: preserve native button activation/disabled and aria-current through the public component, leaving focus/motion to FsusUI; no rendered acceptance claim.

## Coding Convention

- [x] C# mother-style mapping checked
- [x] Formatter/linter run: original strict-full checker, all rules retained; zero violations on base and head.
- [x] No tool default overrides repository style
- [x] Mechanical formatting separated from logic: no unrelated formatting or format-only claim
- [x] `.git-blame-ignore-revs` updated when applicable: not applicable
- Formatter identity: none
- Formatter version: none
- Formatter command: none
- Formatter idempotence evidence: none
- Blame-ignore revision: none

## External Naming Exception

- Exceptions manifest: none

## Documentation / Intent

- [x] Public API docs updated: no API/contract change; existing public component contracts are consumed.
- [x] Ownership/security/performance intent updated
- [x] Historical handoff archived or source-of-truth updated: no historical evidence copied/promoted.
- [x] TODO/FIXME references valid issues: none added.

## Compatibility And Risk

- [x] Cross-language coding conventions reviewed
- [x] Document lifecycle updated: no document/authority change
- [x] External wire / ABI / database / third-party names preserved or explicitly adapted
- [x] Public API impact reviewed
- [x] AEDS frame / binary contract impact reviewed
- [x] Database migration impact reviewed
- [x] Security, auth, moderation, PoW, or privacy impact reviewed
- [x] Docs updated or a reason is recorded below
- [x] Known limitations updated if applicable

## Performance Claim

- Claim level: none
- Evidence path: none
- Non-goals: no performance, runtime, visual/a11y or qualification acceptance claim.

## Release Note

- Audience: internal
- Category: none
- Summary: none

## Generated Output

- Generator source: none
- Generated outputs: none
- Digest/evidence: none
- Automation identity: none

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: none; WIP draft for source review only.
- Rollback: revert this isolated one-file source commit; no data migration or storage operation.
- Deferred work: independent source review and actual rendered/keyboard/focus/theme/viewport acceptance when the external HOLD is lifted. This does not complete #1895's repository-wide governance work.
- Known limitations: all tests/discovery/product module execution/browser/native/DB/qualification/receipt generation and frozen changes remain HOLD. Original failed checks remain failed and are not waived by diagnostic comparisons.

## Notes For Reviewers

WIP — do not merge, mark Ready, close issues or publish. Only the owned production file changes; no tests, policies, baselines, gates, registry or package/configuration changes.

Actual UI961 checkout: `/workspace/review2384/FsusUI`, clean detached HEAD `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3`. The original Blog resolver with `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1` and `FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/review2384/FsusUI` resolves this exact path. Both repository design-conformance Skills apply; ownership is FsusBlog task composition / bounded-composition, with FsusUI owning control states, geometry, keyboard/focus and motion. No classification or acceptance receipt is generated during the requested HOLD.

`@/fsusui/button.ts` re-exports the real public `ElButton` unchanged. UI961 Button retains its native button root, forwards the actual MouseEvent, and exposes the documented public `ref`. The original panel has no DOM ref, manual focus call or focus selector to port, so no new ref/focus mechanism is introduced. Keyed revision identity and the single original click handler remain unchanged. Ordinary noninteractive revision content is composed in the existing product span, not a generic control wrapper.

Wire/API/database/security/qualification checkboxes above record scope review only: no such authority or payload changes here. Source checks do not prove current UX acceptance. Exact head, commands and results will be recorded below.

## Current P2 correction source evidence

- PR base `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`; prior reviewed head `efc04f894c97acd25e3700d7d3a416d70a3e22ed`; new exact head `bb6a4476a15fcba3a3f477c386fd12a4705c06db`. New owned-file blob `4716a11b72c148be96db83270a87f2715c24ced6`. Overall PR remains one changed file (+26/-24); this correction is exactly two color declaration replacements (+2/-2) in that same owned path. Draft/WIP is retained.
- Source diagnosis: real UI961 `fsus-theme.scss` assigns primary Button background/border and a matching foreground directly, including hover/focus and disabled states. The title's fixed body color overrode that foreground. The fixed tertiary color on meta/actor had the same ownership problem. Replace both declarations with `color: inherit`; no palette, token, private selector or UI patch is introduced, and the existing public plain/default-primary/inline-action variants are retained.
- Secondary text inspection: the revision summary and actor share the corrected inherited-color rule. SemanticTime renders a time element and defines no color/style of its own; it inherits through the meta span. Local asset sources contain no generic time color override. Font sizes (title 14, secondary 12) and title weight (700) remain unchanged. Disabled text now also follows the Button's disabled foreground. This is static source reasoning, not inspected/computed browser contrast or rendered acceptance.
- No template/script/variant/layout/handler changes in the P2 correction. Exact revision object payload, click/event order, aria-current, loading/rollbacking disable, keyed order/reselection and all rollback settings/handlers remain byte-identical to the prior head. No ref/focus flow or revision authority changes.
- Original strict command freshly rerun before and after: `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/review2384/FsusUI node tools/frontend/check-frontend-style.mjs --mode strict-full --file src/frontend/src/components/admin/article/ArticleRevisionPanel.vue`. Both exit 0: `ok files=1 eslint=1 stylelint=1 violations=0 new=0`. No reduced config, rules, mocks, skips, gates or baseline changes.
- Original complete application command freshly rerun before and after: `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/review2384/FsusUI node src/frontend/scripts/run-local-fsusui-typecheck.mjs --application`. Final comparison is recorded below. It uses the original full application include scope and the real clean UI961 checkout `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3` via the original local alias resolver.
- `git diff --check` and exact PR range diff checks pass. Only ArticleRevisionPanel.vue changes; UI/checkers/config/gates/tests/frozen/baselines and all other production paths remain unchanged. No runtime/tests/discovery/product module execution/browser/native/DB/qualification or receipt generation was run. Actual themes, selected/hover/focus/disabled contrast and keyboard/reselection/rollback UX remain HOLD/UNRUN for independent review; no acceptance or #1895 completion claim.
- Raw source-check logs remain local in `/workspace/review1895-r15/FsusBlog/.tmp/revision-r15/p2-*.log`, not committed or presented as qualification receipts.

- Final exact-head full application result: before and after both exit 2, **29-to-29 FAIL**, with byte-identical complete raw logs (`cmp`); both SHA-256 `b94c1d06d43b4f1902b34c5d75cb3e13b17bdb14724a2cea70155aec9e2f89c4`. No new diagnostic; original application failures remain and are not waived. Strict before/after raw logs also match, SHA-256 `ad804f48ff95445ecec8bf660c042f38ecb9ca56bcbf9f878c1463277ae87577`.
